liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (3 reviews): Here Comes Sunshine slides seamlessly into China Cat and I Know You Rider; the reviewer laments the trio never returned; China Cat's intro is rushed because Sunshine is usually much faster; Bobby's riff shows it. The transition sounds studio-clean [6][10][11]
- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews): Donna's screams in this song are criticized as badly flat; Playing In The Band is called pretty good [12][14]
- **I Know You Rider** (2 reviews): The rockin' Rider has Jerry leading the charge, with ripping solos; Transition from China Cat into Rider is called seamless and worth downloading [10][16]
- **Wave That Flag** (1 review): Reviewer always enjoys Wave That Flag and They Love Each Other from this era [14]
- **//You Ain't Woman Enough** (1 review): Donna Jean's lead vocal here is described as terrible [12]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Here Comes Sunshine into China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider is called the show's peak [8]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Bob Weir is judged subpar on this song and on One More Saturday Night [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Crowd/Equipment Repair**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-02-17.sbd.ashley-field.32875.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 29 songs; 185 min; rated 4.71/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: A 16khz spike in two signatures is likely CRT horizontal EMI picked up during recording [1]
- **gd1973-02-17.163792.sbd.fixed.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 28 songs; 185 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: The mix on The Promised Land and He's Gone is a mess; Stella Blue is cut at the end and Truckin' loses its beginning [2]
- **gd1973-02-17.sbd.miller.32580.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 28 songs; 185 min; rated 4.38/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: Pops and level problems were fixed with Cool Edit Pro 2.0; still imperfect but more complete [3]
- **gd1973-02-17.150300.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 28 songs; 185 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: The mix on The Promised Land and He's Gone is a mess; Stella Blue ends cut; Truckin' starts cut, and Goin' Down The Road has a crossfade covering a dropout [4]
- **gd73-02-17.sbd.carman.11771.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 142 min; rated 3.53/5 by 17 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard mix close to perfect; Tape is not very crisp, but the overall mix is called incredible; Technical difficulties mar The Promised Land and He's Gone; elsewhere the tape sounds quite crisp [6][10][11][14]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes the first set seems incomplete and asks whether the rest exists [11]
- Reviewer says the venue was the Met Center, not the Civic Center [13]
- A fight broke out at the end of Casey Jones; Bobby W. spoke sharply and the band left [13]
- Some segments are missing, though the band had already played a long full concert [13]
- Show judged fairly typical for the period, but the February 1973 run is rated alongside May 1977 [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-02-17.sbd.ashley-field.32875.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Jay Ashley and Gary Field; source: Bertha Remaster of multi-signature source (shn id 32580) [1]. Also: Spectral analysis shows three distinct signatures in the original source material [1]
- **gd1973-02-17.163792.sbd.fixed.miller.flac1648**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 23, 2023; source: SBD > Reel Master (7.5ips 1/2trk) > Reel/1 (7.5ips/Dolby B) > DAT/0 (Panasonic SV-3800/48k) [2]. Also: Source has a fixed Row Jimmy, edited-out tunings, and patch material credited to Matt Smith and Joe B. Jones [2]
- **gd1973-02-17.sbd.miller.32580.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat -> CD D [3]. Also: Several songs are patched from a soundboard-to-cassette-to-CD source, supplied by Matt Smith [3]
- **gd1973-02-17.150300.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 26, 2020; source: SBD > Reel Master (7.5ips 1/2trk) > Reel/1 (7.5ips/Dolby B) > DAT/0 (Panasonic SV-3800/48k) [4]. Also: Cassette-lineage patch supplies complete Beat It On Down The Line and Me And Bobby McGee tracks [4]
- **gd73-02-17.sbd.carman.11771.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]
